before: orderedReplacedSuggestions named a record a suggestion took over (policy 2) on an item hidden for good, such as a paragraph in a column the organiser deleted directly. The Word file holds no change record there, so a fold named nothing and the card's report differed live and after a fold.
after: takenChanges in compose/replaced.ts passes over items hidden for good (isHidden): the report names only records that show, live and after a fold. A pending deletion still shows the record struck, and the report names it.
reason: Change messages, the change log and its kinds keep their meaning, and the Yjs document format and the checkpoint format do not change. Only the replaced-change report of such a card changes, and it now equals the report after a fold. An ordered room admits only clients of its own code version.
